name: VoltAI
tagline: EV charging stations across Uzbekistan, plus a trip planner
role: Our own product — mobile app, website and station API

scenes.title: For EV drivers
scenes.body: The product site, in Uzbek, Russian and English, with store links ready for launch.

scenes.title: 580 stations on one live map
scenes.body: Several charging networks in one catalog, with live status and filters for power, connector and city.

scenes.title: Trips planned around your car
scenes.body: Add your car, today's charge and a start city; the server plans the charging stops.

scenes.title: Compare plans before you go
scenes.body: Fastest vs. most-buffer options, with charge time per stop and the battery left on arrival.

scenes.title: Private by design
scenes.body: No account needed: cars and preferences stay on the phone, and trips send only coordinates and car specs.
